finding: Repeated track IDs / weighting and split leakage
implemented_decision: One observation per ID; preserve genre memberships; group related recordings when splitting

finding: Conflicting audio or popularity for an ID
implemented_decision: Exclude conflicting IDs from all downstream analyses
tradeoff: Lose ambiguous tracks and genre coverage

finding: Invalid values / undetected tempo or metre
implemented_decision: Drop flagged listings; retain valid rare metre codes and valid zero audio scores
tradeoff: May remove genuine silence or music whose beat is hard to detect

implemented_decision: Preserve labels; unique-track geometry; never interpret genre counts as market prevalence
tradeoff: Cannot correct unknown population sampling probabilities

implemented_decision: Keep valid audio tracks; fill metadata with empty strings
tradeoff: Metadata identity and artist inference weaker for these tracks

implemented_decision: Exclude from continuous geometry; one-hot encode for regressions
tradeoff: Geometry does not capture key or metre; encoding does not model tonal relationships
